Bulk Excel Template Guidelines

Follow these guidelines to prevent validation errors

Header Column Name Mandatory? Format / Accepted Values Description & Important Notes
full_name Required Text (e.g. Ravi Kumar) Full display name of the user.
username Required Text (e.g. ravi_k) Unique login username. Must not exist already in the database.
email Required Valid Email (e.g. ravi@gmail.com) Unique email address. Must not exist already in the database.
role Required user or admin User permission role.
contact_no Optional Text / Digits (e.g. '9860000000)
⚠️ Important: Format cell as Text in Excel (or type ' before the number) to prevent scientific notation (9.86E+09).
department Optional Text (e.g. BBA, BCA) Must match the exact {{ terminology.deptLabel }} name created under your Institute in the system.
team Optional Text (e.g. 2025, Batch A) Must match the exact {{ terminology.teamLabel }}/Batch name created under your Institute.
campus Optional Text (e.g. Main Branch) Must match an existing Campus in your Institute, or leave empty if no campus setup exists.
joining_date Optional YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY Joining date (e.g., 2024-07-25 or 25-07-2024).
password Optional Text (e.g. User@12321) Initial login password. If left empty, defaults to User@12321.
